traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Peraceae: leaves usually alternate, rarely opposite; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; stipules present or absent; plants monoecious or dioecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in heads; perianth tepals or absent; fruit capsule; stamens 2 to 5; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
